page.overview:
Who is Sandy Fries?

Sandy Fries was a Human Starfleet officer in the 24th century. He was a flag officer with the rank of admiral in 2364.

That year, he was a Starfleet Mission Operations Unit officer. On stardate 41305.2, he sent an order about the Gamma Argus system to Captain Jimmy Arakaki of the . His name, rank, and current assignment were mentioned in the order's heading. (, okudagram)
